_about: Ablation and calibration evidence for timed-1. Each row is a tools/bench.py run set on the bicycle backend (seed 0) with the controller config named in 'variant'; 'base' is experiments/configs/timed_default.yaml (and the module defaults). These runs were made during tuning on a busy machine, so the latency columns are indicative only; the latency claims in docs/timed_audit.md come from the committed experiments/bench/latency*.json.

ablations.result: 100% exact decisions; certline's published line is not used as a prior at all, so the objective contains no reference-tracking term (docs/timed_controller.md §3)

ablations.verdict: rejected: the executed pedal resolution is load-bearing
rejected (non-monotone: fewer feasible plans -> recovery mode)
rejected: model optimistic at the limit

ablations.result: found UNSOUND from outside the corridor (progress rate is clamped, not bounded); with a deliberately bad incumbent it returned a worse plan

calibration.source: autocross/backends/bicycle.py defaults fitted to CARLA telemetry (config/sim.yaml vehicle.bicycle)

measured.steady_state_understeer: neutral up to |ay| ~ 5 m/s^2 (K_us ~ 0 within measurement noise); the linear single-track model matches r within 0.03 rad/s below saturation
measured.grip_limit: measured |ay| max 9.4-9.5 m/s^2 in the backend; modelled dynamics saturate at MU_T=0.97, constraint budget MU=0.87
measured.actuator: steer_time_constant 0.06 s -> per-tick lag factor 0.65334 for 10x2.5 ms substeps; harness slew 2.0/s = 50 milli per 25 ms tick
measured.longitudinal: full throttle 5.2 m/s^2 below 20 m/s; full brake -8.9 m/s^2; coasting -0.13 to -0.28 m/s^2 (drag 0.55 m^2 + rolling 0.012)
